data.name: Flesh & Fiber
data.detailed_description:
Flesh & Fiber is a open-world survival horror game where players must scavenge, build, and evolve in a land slowly overtaken by a parasitic infection. Start with nothing but your hands and a few scattered resources, and rises through the ages. From crafting crude stone tools to high powered firearms, and tapping into the infection itself.

The infection begins subtly, quiet and in the background. But over time, the signs emerge: strange mutations in animals, unnatural behaviors, and decay creeping through the environment.
Survive long enough to fight it off… or slowly succumb to the corruption.

==Core Gameplay Features==

Survival and Exploration

Gather resources, hunt, and endure in a procedurally generated world that becomes more hostile the longer you survive.

Deep Crafting and Progression

Advance through distinct Technological eras. From stone and wood to steam, steel, and more. Unlock powered workstations, basic automation, and higher tier weapons to keep up with the evolving threat.

Infection Mechanics

The infection isn't static. it reacts to you. As you progress, so does it. Expect new mutations, shifting environments, and increasingly aggressive infected forms that grow more dangerous over time.

Multiplayer Support

Gather a small team of friends to fight along side the growing problem. Or brave the horrors alone.

Combat and Defense

Equip yourself with a variety of weapons: handmade axes, stun lances, bows, firearms, and more. Every tool is a lifeline against the growing danger.

A Living, Changing World

As the infection spreads, the world warps. Peaceful wilderness gives way to something dark and twisted. The deeper you go, the more the world changes. Flesh & Fiber rewards curiosity, persistence, and a sharp survival instinct.

data.short_description: Flesh & Fiber is a survival horror game where players scavenge, craft, and build their way from primitive stone tools to advanced military technology in a world slowly succumbing to a mysterious parasitic infection. Fight to survive as nature turns against you.
